python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/strings/str_replace_arrays.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    // `__rt_str_replace` takes the same register roles the scalar lowering hands it.
    emitter.instruction("mov rsi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 72]");                       // search pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov rdx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 80]");                       // search length
    emitter.instruction("mov r9, QWORD PTR [rbp - 40]");                        // subject pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov r10, QWORD PTR [rbp - 48]");                       // subject length
    emitter.instruction("push r10");                                            // the sixth argument travels on the stack
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_str_replace");
    emitter.instruction("add rsp, 8");'''
new='''    // `__rt_str_replace` takes the register roles its LOWERING hands it — rax/rdx = search,
    // rdi/rsi = replace, rcx/r8 = subject. The doc comment above that helper names a different
    // set; the code and its caller agree with each other, and this follows them.
    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, rcx");                                        // replacement pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov rsi, r8");                                         // replacement length
    emitter.instruction("mov rax, QWORD PTR [rbp - 72]");                       // search pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov rdx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 80]");                       // search length
    emitter.instruction("mov rcx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 40]");                       // subject pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov r8, QWORD PTR [rbp - 48]");                        // subject length
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_str_replace");'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('x86 ABI corrected from the caller')
